Before doing anything in this repository, read and follow `AGENTS.md` and every file in `project-guidelines/`.
Key rules: never edit without explicit permission (plan first), ask when uncertain, log changes in `project-changelog/YYYY-MM-DD/` (untracked/.gitignored items exempt), back up prior component versions in `version-control/`, present UI mockups (static HTML in `/project-mockups/`) before building any UI, document new env variables in `/.env_example` with empty values and annotations, keep a single root `/.gitignore`, never expose secrets/keys/PII, and double check staged changes for secrets or private mentions before every commit. This repo is PUBLIC.
